title: roi-mammo: code for "Region-of-Interest Augmentation for Mammography Classification: A Controlled Evaluation of Label-Free, Brightness-Ranked Cropping under Patient-Level Splits"
description: Code, pre-registered analysis plan (with addenda A and B), the placement-matched control, the post-review reanalysis and the data checks for a controlled evaluation of label-free, saliency-guided region-of-interest (ROI) cropping as a training augmentation for breast-level mammogram classification on Mini-DDSM and CMMD, compared with standard augmentation, RandomResizedCrop, CutMix, size-matched random crops and placement-matched random boxes. Version 1.2 adds the checks of the third review (box sizes per bank, CMMD subsets, white-patch removal, training loss per arm). Accompanies arXiv:2509.20585 (v3).
